training.model: GRU4 trained only on non-JAWS cohorts using current observe action, current outcome, and session progress; Ridge probe from hidden state to intact-data active-belief coordinate

interpretation: The raw learned-latent ON/OFF shift is directionally consistent in 9/10 animals, but disappears after matching/adjusting current action-outcome composition. Therefore it is not independent evidence that VTA JAWS directly perturbs the learned GRU latent; the current learned coordinate still mixes slow history with event composition.
decision: Retain as diagnostic audit only. Do not use the raw P=0.00488 as a headline causal claim. Stage23's exact replay / belief-coordinate result remains the causal anchor until a composition-robust learned-state test passes.
